requirement.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF ice_condition = 'open water', THEN sea_ice_concentration_tenths < 1 AND ice_of_land_origin_present = false.
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: Open water means a large area of freely navigable water in which sea ice is present in concentrations less than 1/10. No ice of land origin is present.
